SGK PUBLISHING LAB · ARCHITECTURE VERIFICATION

Comic Dialogue Delivery Lab

Comparing all 3 implementation techniques on the exact same modern Madhubani artwork (ch01-scene2-panel2-modern-network-cable.jpg) and dialogue.

METHOD 1 Integrated Comic Strip Frame (Cell Architecture)
✓ 100% Uncovered Artwork · Fully Responsive

Design: The illustration remains completely uncropped (100% width, 16:9). Speech balloons sit in the frame border directly adjacent to the image with directional pointer tails pointing to each character. Zero pixels of artwork are obscured.

🧘‍♂️ SAMEER · STAFF ARCHITECT

"When you press the menu app, does the menu live inside that tablet?"

👨‍💻 AKSHAY · JUNIOR QA

"No, it fetches it across the campus network. The tablet just displays what the network returns."

METHOD 2 Vector SVG Composite (Balloons Inside Canvas Coordinates)
✓ Symmetrical Vector Scaling · Inside Image Frame

Design: The 1376×768 image is embedded inside an SVG viewBox. Vector speech paths are drawn directly over the upper white wall space with bezier pointer tails targeting Sameer and Akshay.

METHOD 3 HTML Floating Percentage Balloons (CSS Absolute Overlay)
✓ Native HTML Elements · Selectable Text

Design: Floating HTML speech bubbles placed via percentage coordinates (top: 6%; left: 5%) over a relative 16:9 container.

🧘‍♂️ SAMEER

"When you press the menu app, does the menu live inside that tablet?"

👨‍💻 AKSHAY

"No, it fetches it across the campus network. The tablet just displays what the network returns."

Architectural Trade-Off Analysis

Attribute Method 1: Integrated Frame Method 2: Vector SVG Method 3: HTML Percentage Overlay
Artwork Protection 100% visible (0% covered) Uses upper white wall space Uses upper white wall space
Mobile Responsiveness Flawless (text flows naturally) Scales with SVG viewBox Text can become small on narrow screens
DOCX / PDF Export 100% native Word tables Can be baked via @resvg/resvg-js Word drops absolute CSS
Reading Ergonomics Highest readability (clear visual hierarchy) Classic graphic novel look Classic graphic novel look
